# Archguard

> Archguard checks how a repository fits together: rules over the resolved dependency graph of the whole repository, repository structure rules, custom TypeScript/Rust rules over the same graph, and review tools for duplicated code and test gaps (mutation testing).

## Compared with Oxlint

Oxlint covers per-file rules, banning an import by name, import cycles, and type-aware rules. Archguard adds transitive path rules (client -> shared -> server), package public-entry and dependency rules, transitive call-origin rules, file roles, companion files, registry imports, plugins over one shared resolved graph, structural duplicate detection, and mutation testing. dependency-cruiser and eslint-plugin-boundaries overlap with the path and package rules.

## Contracts

Exit 0: every selected file parsed, every internal import resolved, all rules pass. Exit 1: complete analysis with rule violations. Exit 2: incomplete analysis or invalid configuration. Selectors never add files to discovery. Archguard runs only plugin and provider commands that are explicitly configured. Duplicate and mutation reports exit 0 when complete, even with findings.

## Start

- [Evaluate a repository with an agent](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/guides/evaluate.md): install the irudd-ts-evaluate skill and give it a time and disk budget.
- [README: build and first check](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/README.md)
- [Full reference](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/README.md): configuration, file selection, import resolution, every rule kind, plugins, compiler member checks, caching.
- [Every rule kind](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/guides/rules.md) and [repository rules](https://github.com/alundgren/irudd-ts/blob/main/docs/guides/repository-rules.md)
- [Examples as JSON](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples.json)

## Examples

- [Keep server code out of the client](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/block-server/index.md): Each import looks fine on its own. Archguard follows the whole path and flags the client reaching the server.
- [Make other code use a package's public entry](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/public-entry/index.md): Stop code from reaching into a workspace package's private files.
- [Keep a package's dependency list clean](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/package-dependencies/index.md): Stop a domain package from picking up React.
- [Keep runtime calls at the edge](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/block-calls/index.md): Flag domain code that imports a module calling Effect.runPromise, directly or through a helper.
- [Enforce a team import convention](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/service-namespace/index.md): T3 Code imports Effect services as namespaces. Three pull requests fixed this by hand.
- [Give every file a known role](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/classify-files/index.md): Catch files that land outside your folder conventions.
- [Require files that belong together](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/companions/index.md): Every service needs its layer file next to it.
- [Never forget to register a migration](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/registry-imports/index.md): The registry must import every migration file.
- [Write your own rule over the whole graph](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/typescript-plugin/index.md): Plugins get the same resolved graph as the built-in rules. This one does the client-to-server check by hand.
- [Find copy-pasted logic](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/find-duplicates/index.md): Groups functions with the same structure, even after variables were renamed.
- [Find code changes your tests miss](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/run-mutations/index.md): Archguard makes small edits, like >= to >, and runs your tests on a copy. An edit no test notices shows a gap.
- [Let your agent try Archguard on your repo](https://alundgren.github.io/irudd-ts/examples/agent-evaluation/index.md): Give your agent a time and disk budget. It looks for rules that fit, copy-pasted code, and test gaps.
